messages:
Elaine (CS): kicking off Mistral Health onboarding thread — want to align on stakeholders, success criteria, risks, and a tentative timeline. Olivia, appreciate if you can confirm primary contacts from your side.

Matt (AE): adding here — Mistral signed for Dedicated tier, go-live target is end of Q2. Billing/contract questions tracked separately.

Olivia (Mistral Health): thanks! Primary contacts: me (product lead) and Raj (SRE). We'll need data isolation and HIPAA notes covered.

Sam (Solutions Eng): noted on HIPAA. I'll schedule a tech deep-dive week of Apr 18. Can someone confirm typical sequence lengths and peak QPS? Even ballpark helps with autoscaling config.

Olivia (Mistral Health): sequence lengths mostly ~1k tokens, occasional 5k. Peak: we expect ~120 concurrent sessions to start, ramping to 500 after month 2.

Priya (Onboarding): draft timeline suggestion: week 0 kickoff -> week 1 infra prep & keys -> week 2 integration & smoke -> week 3 performance tuning -> week 4 training + handoff. Is that ok?

Elaine (CS): that aligns. Success criteria we should track: 1) stable production latency p95 < 600ms for 1k tokens, 2) secure data flow with KMS integrated, 3) org enablement + runbook handed off.

Sam (Solutions Eng): for latency target I'll propose batching policy and quantization profile in the tuning week — may need to tweak if 5k sequences are common. Also flagging token cost estimates for finance.

Matt (AE): renewal risk note: customer wants guaranteed isolation and a plan for burst capacity. Recommend we map SLA expectations to Reserved capacity options in the contract amendment.

Olivia (Mistral Health): can you share what burst window looks like and any cost tradeoffs? We need predictability.

Sam (Solutions Eng): burst options: we can do short-term burst on Hosted pool with fallback to lower-cost model variant. I'll send a short matrix by EOD: latency vs cost vs isolation.

OnboardBot: Reminder — please fill onboarding intake form: https://redwood.app/onboard-intake/mistral (status: not complete).

Priya (Onboarding): action items I see: 1) Olivia & Raj confirm sequence distribution + traffic window (Olivia), 2) Sam to send burst/variant matrix (Sam), 3) Sam+Elaine schedule HIPAA compliance call with Security (Elaine), 4) Priya to send calendar invites for weekly syncs.

Olivia (Mistral Health): will get Raj to post sequence histogram by EOD tomorrow. Also happy to do weekly sync Fridays.

Elaine (CS): great — I'll loop in Security and Solutions Eng on HIPAA checklist. Add any other questions here; otherwise I'll lock the kickoff agenda and send calendar invites tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Matt (AE): thanks team. Keeping an eye on billing and reserved capacity agreement.

Sam (Solutions Eng): uploading a short config snippet for the smoke test next message.

Sam (Solutions Eng): ```yaml
smoke_test:
  model: rdx-4b-quant
  seq_len: 1024
  concurrency: 20
  duration: 5m
```

Olivia (Mistral Health): perfect, thanks Sam. Looking forward to kickoff.

Elaine (CS): closing notes: primary goal is successful secure go-live end of Q2, mitigate renewal risk by meeting latency & isolation targets. I'll post the invite + agenda shortly.
